The grievance of the Petitioners as articulated in the present Writ Petition is that the Petitioners'
right to livelihood is being affected.

It is stated by the learned Counsel for the Petitioners that the Respondent Nos. 15 to 17 and 21 could not close the food and beverages outlet during the Covid- 19 pandemic without the permission of the Central Government.
It is further stated that the action that was taken by the Respondents was dehors the law.

2. Learned Counsel for the Respondent Nos. 15 to 17 and 21 disputes the same and submits that there several disputes in the present Petition which include the fact that the Petitioners are not employees of the Respondents and that the petition, as filed, is not maintainable before this Court.

3. It is apposite to set out the prayers in the present Petition, which reads as follows:
